svg.title: Smoke Signal workflow
svg.desc: How feedback moves from a staff member through Sig, routing, Admin approval and Digital Staff work to a closed item, with the tracker stages staff see and the Friday release.
svg.text: From a staff member's message to a closed item. Red lines are the status an item holds at that step.
Follows it on the tracker (5 stages)
Bell and email at each change.
Can reply or add details; a reply
on a Resolved item reopens it
The model proposes; code decides who gets it,
never the model. Roles are checked on the
server. Staff see only their own items.
Every change writes the tracker history and notifies the submitter
and followers: bell at once, email from the worker
Any time while open: post updates, set Expected by,
reassign, merge a duplicate (Declined), or close as
Won't fix (Declined) or No longer needed (Closed)
What staff see on the tracker
Nine internal statuses sit behind five stages.
Closed (Fixed, No longer needed), Declined (Won't fix,
Needs review items over a day old go to the triage lead;
a summary of approvals waiting goes to the Admins
